changes.evidence: The initial g, reduced r/o/u, descending p and final long low stroke are visible. There is no securely separable terminal s; the long terminal stroke could conceal one. Singular is the literal first reading, with plural retained as an ink possibility.
A tall crossed f, low o/r/m, small e and looped l are followed by one long down-hooked exit. That exit does not securely distinguish a final s from the end of l.
The i has a separate point. There is no two-stroke roof or circumflex above it.

The word stops after c/o and two reduced m waves. The final down-hook is continuous with m. The two detached specks are substantially below and left of the exit, rather than a full stop after the word; no following letters support the expansion.
One nearly horizontal shaft ends in a short upward bend. It lacks the two diagonals of the independently visible final arrowhead. This resolves the C doubt to the drawn hooked shaft.

notes.text: The continued opening attributes the stated concentration in commutative formal groups to Dieudonné with semble-t-il. The page begins mid-sentence; no missing antecedent or opening quotation was supplied.

The author asks for a generalization to groups in (n-cat), expects chain complexes abbreviated non comm, and asks for additional structures of the crossed-oval type. The phrases on s’attend, sans doute and mais lesquelles ? are the author’s qualifications, not verification results.

The main prose identifies these structures with truncated homotopy types of topological groups at dim ≤ n. The interlinear text gives a bound ≤ n+1 for connected pointed/punctuated topological spaces; its exact truncation word/state and one accent remain open. Both inequalities were read from their strokes independently.
As-tu des ... à proposer ? requests candidates; the spelling/dotting of candidats is retained as uncertain.

The lower paragraph connects biduality and inserted homology to developments partly already existing and partly demanding substantial elaboration, introducing reminiscences. The adjective in the final line remains uncertain; no grammatical or idiomatic repair is made.

Mathematical expectations prompted attention to all objects and connectors in the chain, the n-minus-tick subscript, the crossed-oval case and each dimension bound. This run performed no targeted proof check, re-proof, computation or use of an external theorem. The checks list is therefore empty.

This is a wholly handwritten continuation sheet, author number 6, archive pencil 151, with two textual additions, two distinct guides and one separator. No date, salutation, signature, independent marginal note or typed underlayer appears. A possible cancellation is kept uncertain within the interlinear word.

Two isolated points have uncertain intentional status: the C-marked one before Tes, and a newly recorded point below the first guide immediately before As-tu. The two specks below comm were judged off-baseline rather than terminal punctuation.

The first recorded UTC timestamp is immediately before the image phase; the permitted textual instructions and witnesses had just been read. Whole image and each supplied half were displayed once only. Thirteen crop files were generated with the supplied crop.py at width 2800, using its logged contrast 1.12; the slanted interlinear/question crops were rotated 1.5 degrees. The crop script was invoked, not inspected. No OCR, browsing, other pages/readers, delegation or LaTeX compilation was used. The final consistency check is syntactic and documentary, not a mathematical check event.

coverage: Read the whole sheet once for layout, then the supplied upper and lower halves once each in that order. Every physical prose line was read in sequence against both complete witnesses, including all agreed words, endings, accents, apostrophes and punctuation; line-end word divisions were joined. The complete chain was inspected object by object and connector by connector, the two inequalities independently, all quote strokes, both interlinear states and their attachment lines, the separator, page number, archive foliation and all margins. Thirteen single focused crops addressed the places still open after the halves; no half was enlarged again and no locus was re-cropped. C’s nine doubt loci all have explicit retained or resolved entries. The report includes every substantive C/H wording, state, glyph and graphic difference found. H expands comm, adds accents/points or typographic forms at some locations, and does not reproduce the separator or guides graphically; its note acknowledges the first guide. C does not reproduce either insertion guide. Both witnesses omit the small possible point inside the first guide. No unrecoverable prose gap is silently filled, and all residual lexical or state uncertainties are expressed in reading.tex.
